title: Two devices send the same local_id
steps: 1. Ankit syncs School_1 2. Pooja syncs School_1
expected_result: Two server records with different server_ids; each keeps its own answers

title: Two devices send the same local_id at the same instant
steps: Send both batches in parallel 25 times
expected_result: Always exactly two intact records; no lost update

title: Same real school from two workers is flagged
steps: Pooja syncs same school name (different spelling/case) and village
expected_result: Stored as a new record with possible_duplicate flag linking to Ankit's; nothing merged

title: Same name in a different village is not flagged
steps: Pooja syncs same name with another village_code
expected_result: Status created; no duplicate flag

title: Local ID reused after app reinstall
steps: Same device sends School_1 with a new client_uuid
expected_result: New record created; old one untouched

title: Full batch retried after response was lost
steps: Send the identical batch again
expected_result: already_synced with the same server_id; record count unchanged

title: Idempotency-Key replay
preconditions: First call made with a key
steps: Repeat with same key
expected_result: Identical status and body; Idempotent-Replay header true

title: Idempotency-Key reused with a different body
preconditions: First call made with a key
steps: Repeat with same key but another record
expected_result: 422; nothing stored from the second call

title: Same client_uuid but different answers
steps: Resend with changed answers
expected_result: 409 conflict; stored answers unchanged

title: Mixed batch: one conflict + one new record
steps: Send changed version of it plus a new record
expected_result: 207 with per-record statuses conflict and created; new record saved; original unchanged

title: Partial batch retry
steps: Send both
expected_result: Statuses already_synced and created; total 2

title: Missing or invalid fields
steps: Remove device_id / user_id / local_id / client_uuid; bad UUID; answers not object; bad date; empty records
expected_result: 400 with field-level error; nothing stored

title: Malformed JSON
steps: Send truncated JSON
expected_result: 400 Invalid JSON

title: Batch too large
steps: Send 101 records
expected_result: 413; app must split into chunks

title: Unicode / Hindi text
steps: Sync Hindi school name and remarks
expected_result: Stored byte-for-byte

title: Thundering herd at 5 PM (behaviour)
steps: 150 devices sync at once then retry after Retry-After
expected_result: No 500s; load is actually shed; overload gets 429/503 + Retry-After; all 150 stored exactly once

title: 50000-device spike (capacity)
steps: k6 ramp 0 -> 50000 virtual devices in 2-5 min then soak
expected_result: p95 < 2 s; 5xx < 0.1%; zero lost or duplicated records

title: Single device in a retry loop
steps: One device sends 12 requests at once
expected_result: Some 429 with Retry-After

title: Tests catch the overwrite bug
steps: npm run verify:buggy
expected_result: The duplicate-ID and idempotency tests fail while validation tests still pass

title: Auth token of another user
steps: Ankit's device sends a batch with Pooja's user_id
expected_result: 403 (not in mock - needs real auth)

title: Photo upload interrupted at 99%
steps: Drop connection near end of multipart upload
expected_result: Upload resumes or restarts; survey not marked synced until photo confirmed; no orphan record

title: Device clock wrong by days
steps: Sync
expected_result: Server keeps collected_at as sent but records received_at; flags impossible dates

title: Survey collected on old schema version
steps: Sync answers from v3
expected_result: Accepted and mapped by schema_version; not rejected
